heading.description: The label of the field for the large heading the site's home page opens with.

description.description: The label of the field for the paragraph under the home page's heading.

action.description: The label of the field for what the button under the home page's opening paragraph says.

link.description: The label of the field for where the button under the home page's opening paragraph leads.

image.description: The heading over the picture of the home page's hero, which is uploaded on its own.

imageUpload.description: The accessible name of the badge on the home page's picture that picks an image to upload, when it has none.

imageChange.description: The accessible name of the badge on the home page's picture that picks an image to upload in its place.

imageUploading.description: The accessible name of the badge that picks the home page's picture while an upload is under way.

imageRemove.description: The accessible name of the badge on the home page's picture that removes it.

imageRemoving.description: The accessible name of the badge that removes the home page's picture while the removal is under way.

imageConfirm.defaultMessage: Remove the hero image? The site will show its own picture of the church.
imageConfirm.description: The question asked before the home page's picture is removed, and what the site shows after.

imageInvalid.defaultMessage: That file can’t be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of 4 MB or less.
imageInvalid.description: The error shown when the file picked for the home page's picture is not an image of an accepted kind, or is too large.

imageNone.description: The accessible name of the placeholder shown where the home page has no picture uploaded.
